Hi all,

Quick update after a preliminary run of the reconciliation (attached ZIP contains logs and the per-request sample):
- Root cause: a short-lived CI job used CloudWave's API key on 2026-11-29 03:14:xx UTC which caused ~320k extra inference tokens to be attributed to CloudWave's primary tenant. The job retried several times, producing duplicate requests (same request_id across retries). Our attribution pipeline currently dedupes per-request_id but the CI retries altered the session_id which bypassed a dedupe edge-case; we have a fix queued.
- Financial impact: gross overage = €14,092. VAT attributable to EU entity (if that entity is confirmed) = €2,013. If Client confirms US entity is the buyer we will reallocate VAT and issue a corrected invoice.

Proposed remediation:
1) Issue a provisional credit of €14,092 against the December invoice.
2) If CloudWave confirms the EU VAT entity, we will adjust VAT lines and produce a credit note for tax reporting.
3) Deploy a dedupe patch and run a retroactive scrub to prevent future duplicates.

Attachments: recon_run_20261202.zip (logs, 3 files)

Ben
